me.label: Your account
app.notYet: This part of the panel is not built yet.
err.network: The server didn’t answer. Check the connection and try again.
acc.title: Your account
acc.lead: Who you are here, how you sign in, and the tokens your AI clients use to reach memory as you.
acc.name: Name
acc.profileNote: Name and email come from your sign-in provider. To change your role or spaces, ask an administrator.
acc.rootNote: You signed in with the server’s administrator token, which belongs to no account: there is no profile or memory to show here. Link a sign-in method to an administrator account to use the rest of the panel.
gate.tagline: Team memory your agents can recall — every line traceable to where it came from.
gate.noProviders: No sign-in providers are set up on this server yet.
gate.fine: Signing in doesn’t grant access by itself. Your administrator decides who gets in and which spaces they see.
gate.admin.title: Administrator sign-in
gate.admin.redirected: No administrator has linked a sign-in method yet, so /signin brought you here.
gate.admin.hint: The server’s MEMGRES_ADMIN_TOKEN, or your personal mgk_ token.
gate.admin.refused: This token can’t sign in here. It has to be the server’s administrator token or the personal token of a superadmin or user manager.
gate.admin.throttled: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
mem.search: Search this space — words, a title or a path
mem.noSpaces: You can’t see any spaces yet.
mem.noSpacesHelp: Spaces are shared with you by their owners or an administrator. Once one is, it appears in the sidebar.
mem.gone: This space is no longer available to you.
mem.recordGone: This record is no longer here — it may have been moved or removed. Reload the space.
mem.truncatedNote: The map shows the first {shown} of {total} records. Search and the local view still reach all of them.
viz.noD3: The graph couldn’t start. The tree list works without it.
crumbs.label: Path to the root
suggest.text: {records} — the whole space is busy to read.
suggest.noSel: Pick a record and look at its neighbours instead.
suggest.busiest: Local view of the most linked
local.needSel: Select a record first — the local view is built around it
tip.below: path without its own record · {records} below
insp.noHits: Nothing in this space matches. Try other words.
insp.spaceNote: Node size follows the number of links. A dashed outline is a path with no record of its own. Select anything to fade everything unrelated.
insp.dangling: Nothing is written at this path yet
tok.title: Tokens for AI clients
tok.none: No tokens yet. Create one for each device or client you use.
tok.revokeConfirm: Revoke “{label}”? Anything using it stops working immediately.
tok.note: One token per device: losing a laptop means revoking one token, not all of them. Tokens expire on their own; revoked ones stop working immediately.
tok.label: Device or purpose
tok.ceiling: A token never reaches further than your account: in a space you can only read, a write token only reads.
tok.copyNow: Copy it now — it won’t be shown again
tok.fingerprint: Only a fingerprint of it is stored; nobody can show it to you again.
tok.noMcpUrl: This server doesn’t say where its MCP endpoint is, so the address below is an example. Ask your administrator for the real one.
tok.copyFail: Select the token and copy it
auth.pending: Thanks — your sign-in is waiting for an administrator. You’ll get in once they approve it; try again later.
auth.denied_rules: This sign-in provider doesn’t allow you into this memory. If you think that’s wrong, ask your administrator.
auth.denied_no_account: There is no account here for this sign-in, and this provider doesn’t create one. Ask your administrator.
auth.denied_disabled: This account is switched off. Ask your administrator.
auth.denied_rejected: An administrator declined this sign-in recently.
auth.denied_queue_full: Too many sign-ins are waiting for approval right now. Try again later.
auth.denied_taken: That sign-in is already linked to a different account.
auth.denied_same_provider: Your account already has a sign-in from this provider. To use a different one, ask an administrator.
auth.linked: Linked. You can now sign in with it as well.
auth.expired: That sign-in took too long or was opened in another browser. Start again.
auth.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled at the provider.
auth.failed: Sign-in didn’t go through. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell your administrator.
auth.provider_down: The sign-in provider isn’t answering right now. Try again in a few minutes.
signins.title: Linked sign-in methods
signins.addNote: You’ll be sent to the provider and back. The method is added to this account whatever its email.
signins.onlyOne: This is your only way in — an administrator can remove it.
signins.unlinkConfirm: Unlink {name}? Sessions opened with it end now.
signins.none: No sign-in methods are linked to this account.
signins.note: Any linked method opens this same account.
adm.band: Administration — changes here affect everyone on this memory.
adm.title: Administration
req.title: Waiting for a decision
req.note: A request appears when someone signs in through a provider set to wait for approval, or when their email matches an administrator account. No account is created until you decide.
req.whyMatch: Their confirmed email matches {name}. The provider is set to ask before linking.
req.whyAdmin: Their email matches the administrator account {name}. An email alone never links an administrator — only link if you are sure it is them.
req.whyNew: No account has this email. Creating one gives no spaces; share spaces with them afterwards.
req.rejectConfirm: Reject the sign-in of {name}? They won’t be able to request again for 30 days.
req.done.create: Account created for {name} — share spaces with them next
req.whyAdminSuper: Their email matches the administrator account {name}. Only a superadmin can link a sign-in to an administrator; you can create a separate account or reject.
auth.throttled: Too many sign-ins were started from here. Wait a few minutes.
act.title: Writes

act.aria.one: {n} change to memory in the last {weeks} weeks, by day
act.aria.other: {n} changes to memory in the last {weeks} weeks, by day

act.note: Every record created, edited, moved or retagged — by the person or by an agent using one of their tokens. Reading is not counted. Records that were erased take their history with them.
act.noteSelf: Everything you and your agents wrote in the spaces you can open. Reading is not counted.
act.noteShared: Only what they wrote in spaces you can both open.
adm.peopleNote: Search by name, email or department. Open a person to see their spaces, sign-in methods, tokens and what they wrote — and to switch the account off.
insp.linkCopied: Link copied — anyone without access can ask for it there
noacc.title: You can’t open this space
noacc.lead: Either it doesn’t exist, or nobody has shared it with you yet. You can ask the people who run it.
noacc.pending: You asked for {perm} access {ago}. The space’s administrators decide; it appears in your sidebar once they do.
noacc.side: A space appears here once its owner or an administrator lets you in.
people.title: Person
people.notFound: There is nobody here you can look at by this link.
people.adminBand: You are looking at this account as an administrator.
people.emailNote: The email is how invitations and sign-ins find this account. It has to be unique.
people.roleNote: A user manager lets people in and manages accounts; a superadmin can do anything.
people.sessionsNote: Signs them out of the panel everywhere. Their tokens keep working.
people.endConfirm: Sign {name} out of the panel everywhere?
people.disableNote: Switching it off stops every token and session at once. Nothing is deleted, and it can be switched back on.
people.disableConfirm: Switch off {name}? Every token and session stops now.
people.adminOnlySuper: This is an administrator account: only a superadmin can change it.
people.unlinkConfirm: Remove {name} from {person}? Sessions opened with it end now. If it is their only way in, they won’t be able to sign in until another method is linked.
req.pickNote: The sign-in will open this account from now on. Pick carefully: whoever signs in gets everything the account has.
req.pickNoteMgr: The sign-in will open this account from now on. Administrator accounts can only be linked by a superadmin.
req.pickConfirm: Link the sign-in of {name} to {account}? From now on it opens that account.
sp.title: Members & access
sp.notAdmin: Only the administrators of a space can see who is in it.
sp.lead: Who can open this space, and how far.
sp.inviteNote: Someone who already has an account with this email is added now. Anyone else is invited: the space opens for them the first time they sign in with this address confirmed by their sign-in provider, within {days} days. An invitation doesn’t let anyone into the server — that is still up to the sign-in rules and the administrators.
sp.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from {space}? Their tokens stop reaching it at once.
sp.leaveConfirm: Leave {space}? To come back, someone will have to let you in again.
sp.demoteSelf: You are about to lower your own access and won’t be able to manage this space any more. Continue?
sp.invitesNote: An invitation is used once. It stops working if the person who sent it no longer runs this space.
sp.linkNote: Send it to a colleague. If they can’t open the space yet, they can ask for access from there — requests show up above.
sp.transferNone: Add the new owner as a member first.
sp.transferNote: The owner has full access that can’t be taken away. Only the owner or a superadmin can hand the space over.
sp.transferConfirm: Hand {space} to {name}? You will lose access to it.
sp.transferConfirmKeep: Hand {space} to {name}? You stay as an admin.
sp.lapsedWhy: The person who sent it no longer runs this space. Cancel it and invite again.
every.title: All spaces on this server
every.note: You can open any space by your superadmin role, without becoming a member. It appears in the sidebar under your own until you sign out.
every.groupWhy: You are not a member of these spaces: your superadmin role lets you read them. They stay here until you sign out.
every.itemWhy: {name} — not your space; opened by your superadmin role
every.noOwn: You are not a member of any space yet.
every.emptyHelp: As a superadmin you can open any space on this server: “All spaces…” in the sidebar.
every.truncated: Only the first {n} are listed — search to narrow it down.
auth.denied_email_unverified: Your sign-in provider hasn’t confirmed your email address (or didn’t share it). Confirm it there — usually with a code sent to that address — and sign in again. If it looks confirmed, ask your administrator.
recent.title: Recent edits
recent.none: Nothing you can see was changed by this person lately.
recent.note: Only edits in spaces you can open are shown.
recent.noteSelf: Your latest changes, and your agents’, in the spaces you can open.
people.issueTokenNote: For a person who has not signed in yet or a service that only uses tokens. You will see the secret once — hand it over yourself. People who sign in can make their own tokens.
people.canCreateNote: Lets this person make spaces of their own (over MCP, the API or the panel). They own what they make: they can add people to it by email, which confirms whether an address has an account here. Existing spaces are not affected.
adm.newPersonNote: An account with no spaces and no rights. With an email, their first sign-in through a provider finds it (the administrators still approve the sign-in); share spaces with them and issue tokens from their page.
howto.title: How to connect an AI client
howto.step1: Create a token above — one per device or client. Copy the secret: it is shown only once.
howto.step2: Add this memory to your client, putting your token in place of the placeholder:
howto.step3: Restart the client. Check that it works by asking the agent to call memory_whoami — it answers with your name and what the token may do.
howto.safety: A token is a password: do not paste it into chats or commit it to repositories. If one leaks, revoke it here — it stops working at once.
